reviews.text: I get there and the space is warm and welcoming. I love how they have plants there (I am amazed at how these plants are doing well with all the animals that go there). I went there because I was recommended by another vet who was booked and needed immediate help for my baby tabby cat. Everyone did a great job. All were friendly and warm. There were a few things I think can be improved upon as far as getting test results sooner, but perhaps they are low staffed and need help? Otherwise a good place to go. Thank you for helping my cat!
Dr Gill is great but the front desk people are rude and seem to be incompetent.
They helped fix my doggies tail after being told I may have to amputate it. 🥺😊 …

First time and I loved it. Lobby clean and odor free. Entire staff SO KIND and detailed with all information. Everyone treated my dog with so much attention and care. The lobby pet is so cool, really nice bird and the appointment process was smooth easy and fast with many options for booking. I’m so glad my baby has a new vet!

I've called many other places like Army Trail Animal Hospital, Mokena Animal Clinic, Duke Animal Hospital and plenty others to receive an estimate for rabbit neutering and this is the ONLY clinic that will not without first coming in for a $80 fee wellness check. They gave me an estimate before, about a year ago, so I was trying to confirm the price, so I can decide as a low/no income person if i can afford it. Unfortunately,  I'm going elsewhere with the services..

This vet is just okay! I really only go because of appointments are quick. The vet technicians are very nice.  The doctor herself is not that great! My opinion is she is  just about money with her. I brought my dog in yesterday. Im asking questions she giving half answers.  I didn't feel valued as a customer. She dont really speak to you.She doesn't ask questions as far as about your pet since the last visit.  She just let her technicians and students assist you. I don't like that about her.I been going every 3 weeks since April 12th. His ear infection is not cleared up. I have spent over 475 just trying to get his ear infection under control.$ 50 every visit for an ear cleaning  with no real results.  U would think she would waiver an ear cleaning fee  once since we been there since April.  But business is business. Not the fact if your  clients are satisfied and will recommend you to other pet owners.  Honestly, I'm not sure if I will return back to her. Just for an Emergency situation nothing ongoing for my dog again.

Wonderful, polite staff. But never have I been to a vet clinic where they keep animals in lone captivity. They got a chinchilla engaged as a prop in the office. Locked in a small cage by himself all day every day.. and a lone turtle as well. The turtle dont have no type of setup or nothing in the aquarium just water. How can a business that is about helping animals and ensuring the safety and wellbeing of animals for the community can on the otherhand practicing inhumane treatment of their own pets. I can longer patronize this place because of my stance against animal abuse/neglect and everytime I go there my energy shifts.  Never again.
They were able to get us in the same day I called. Nice, clean practice with very kind staff.

I have a large breed dog and I’ve been going here 5yrs now and my dog loves this place, maybe more than me. I’ve had no troubles with Dr. Gill, my dog is very responsive to her and become immediately excited on every visit!

We were able to get a same-day appointment to have our guinea pigs seen for a suspected UTI. The staff and doctor were very warm and welcoming, and after conducting an exam, they were able to prescribe antibiotics to treat the issue. I really appreciated that they didn't try to upsell us on services or push us to do complicated or invasive testing. The prices were very fair. It's hard to find a vet that treats small/exotic animals, and based on our experience, I would certainly recommend this practice.

I initially chose this clinic because of the good reviews, but my experience was terrible and harmful to my guinea pig's health. First, they scheduled two back-to-back guinea pig appointments with only one exotic pet room available, causing a 50-minute wait. When the vet finally arrived, she failed to explain the treatment process and didn’t administer any pain medication, claiming guinea pigs don’t feel pain even though she was clearly suffering.

There was no demonstration on how to clean my guinea pig’s cyst or properly administer antibiotics. When I asked for clarification, the vet seemed irritated and casually mentioned that she could die if not treated correctly, then left without further explanation. I was prescribed three antibiotics, but a week later, they called to say they had forgotten one. The new prescription didn’t provide enough medication for the full course, and there was blatant miscommunication between the vet and staff. The vet told them to extend the antibiotics, while the staff gave conflicting information, further complicating the treatment plan. In the end, they extended the treatment and instructed me to restart the antibiotic. Despite these serious and repeated mistakes, the staff never once apologized.

I have since taken my guinea pig to a new vet who confirmed the previous treatment was excessive and unnecessary. She is now on a proper treatment plan. Please reconsider bringing your exotic pets to this practice

This was a year ago. I updated some information related to her final treatment

This place is so dirty they never clean or something the waiting area is atrocious and mad dust bunnies galore also in the exam rooms same situation hasn’t been dusted in way too long I am not exaggerating the seats in the waiting areas and examination rooms had dried fluids and hair all over nothing looks wiped down floors coming up and they charge top dollar
for 20$ more I can go to the emergency vet on canal and it’s so clean and nice in there and organized I just can’t believe the condition of this place everything and everyone there is so disheveled and un organized 🤦🏻‍♀️👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼

I highly recommend going to this veterinarian, the people are very kind and I loved how they treated me and my dog, I didn't have enough budget because I don't have money, and they helped me and left me the cheapest price, and I thank you very much, many blessings for helping me. ❤️‍🩹

The staff is amiable, knowledgeable, and prompt, the prices were quite reasonable. As a first time client, I felt welcomed as I walked in. My leopard gecko  was taken in and seen by the nicest doctor. She was warm and patient. Definitely recommend this clinic for all pets.

I got a calming collar for my cat.  The doctor cut off the excess which was about half of the collar and kept it .  First, it's upcharged then selfishly kept the remainder.  There were other petty issues.  I will never use this service .

After my hamster died, although this was a few years ago, the reason for the change in rating. Long story short my hamster got sick I took him to this place they examined him he got some food stuck in his teeth the vet gave him some medicine and I asked the vet was my baby gonna be alright the vet said yes but a few days later my baby wasn't getting better and ended up dying in my hands. If they knew my hamster wasn't going to get better then they should have told me but instead they said yes and took the money
Very comfortable animal clinic. Excellent customer service. Im glad thia was the place we selected for our puppy.
Great place to take your pet.

The wait was a little long, but since they were able to fit me in within a couple days, I can’t complain.
Super nice staff and reasonable prices.
The vet and her staff are simply amazing

I have been taking my Yorkie there since he was about 16 weeks and he is now 9 years old. I will not go anywhere else. He don't like the, he won't like any other. ets either. But I love and trust them with my fur baby.

I recently adopted a 2.5 year old rottie mix and I needed to get him set up with a vet.  Bronzeville Animal Clinic is only a few minutes from me and I wanted to stay local and small.  I am so glad I came here; the entire team is so friendly and welcoming from my initial call, to arrival/check-in, to the exam.  Dr. Gill was awesome with my dog, who got a little spooked at one point.  I'm really thankful to have stumbled upon their office!

The facility is conveniently located, and staff are very friendly. However, I felt "in the dark" during the whole visit. 3 people came in to see my cats, but none of them told me who they were, or what they were doing. After they were weighed and received shots, someone took them into another room. I wasn't sure whether I was supposed to wait or follow.

I had some concerns about a few behaviors, but my questions went unanswered.

Love this place and love all the ladies there! You are all very welcoming and helpful. I look forward to my visits. Flexible appointments and payment plans are something else that I like about Bronzeville Animal Clinic

we have taken our dog & 2 guinea pigs here for years. the staff and doctor are always so patient, kind and caring. we’re definitely in good hands here with our pets. thank you for taking care of our little family!

i brought in my guinea pig for about two years. I always asked if she knew how to care for guinea pigs and she said she did. I asked questions about my piggy having food stored in his cheeks, his chin being wet and dirty and always drinking water, she said it was normal and doesn't see anything with him. My piggy was extremely sick and in pain. I took him to the ER and he died. The ER asked about his chin, inside his mouth and his teeth.... the thing is shes not qualified to care for guinea pigs. I spend over $3,000.00 on him thinking she knew what she was doing, to have him died. I don't recommend her/ the vet to care for guinea pigs. I will never go to her again. My emotional support, my boy is gone. I wish I could get all of my money back from her for misdiagnosing him.
Great facility and wonderful people that work there.

We’ve been going to Dr. Gill for a few years now. Everything from ear infections to annual checkups, she loves Mr. Deeds.
She is an absolute Saint! My dog is a 14yr old Shih Tzu which recently had a massive tumor in his neck. Dr. Gill was able to remove the tumor, she is full service there, anesthesia, Bloodwork, etc.,  and we are now on the mend! She is very clear about treatment and health plans. She knows animals!
Kelli, ( we love Kelli!!!) and all of her techs and assistants are so kind and loving toward every animal and their person.

It sometimes gives me Sesame Street vibes because the waiting area includes a cockatoo (Owen), water turtle and sometimes a Chinchilla. It is one of the most remarkable small businesses I frequent and I wish it were more places like this, with a warm environment that feels overwhelming with care.
I love Dr. Gills office that place is a true gem!

Dr. Gill is the best vet
Really cares and loves all animals
Saved my dogs life
So glad we found Dr. Gill and her team. Everyone is kind. Kelli at the reception is cool and funny. Prices are reasonable and care is great!
Love this place! They take good care of my babies and are very fair and reasonable when it comes to pricing
The staff is always so nice, knowledgeable, and caring! Our cats Goro and Natto always feel comfortable here and are taken care of so well.

This  veterian Is the best the best vet I have ever been to, She treats all kinds of animals I Took  my small turtle over there and was very pleased with results, She she already  takescare of My three parakeets .

We’ve taken our dog to Bronzeville Animal Clinic for a few years now and we’ve had a great experience. The staff is friendly and efficient (and they always pick up the phone), and the vet is really nice towards us and our dog. She takes great care of him and explains anything we ask. Definitely recommend!
